item.title: WSL 3 Ships: A Native Linux Container Engine on Windows, 2x Cross-System File Speed
item.description: On September 29, Microsoft moved WSL 3.0.1 to GA, landing the wslc container CLI, the Consomme network mode, and virtiofs file acceleration in one shot. I installed it on Windows 11 and walked through the architecture, networking, and honest limits.
